title: impact-kernel
responsibility: Rust implementation of the impact kernel, built as a native JSON process and a core Wasm module.

outputs.name: impact
outputs.description: Reports the reverse dependency closure of changed IDs plus uncertain IDs only when changed is nonempty; each affected record carries the node ID, nearest seed distance, graph path (via), presence, and seed marker. affected follows head-node order then base-only-node order, uncovered uses head coverage for surviving IDs and base coverage for removed IDs, and unknown lists changed IDs absent from both graphs.

outputs.name: version
outputs.description: The version operation returns the fixed contract identifier implemented by this kernel. Its value is always impact-kernel/1.

errors.name: invalid-json
errors.description: Returned when the request text is malformed JSON or contains values the portable parser refuses, including out-of-range numbers, lone surrogate escapes, or nesting deeper than 64 levels. The failure envelope uses the message "request is not valid JSON".

errors.name: invalid-request
errors.description: Returned when the request is not an object with a string operation, when impact input is not an object, or when an impact field has the wrong JSON shape. The failure envelope identifies the request problem or malformed impact field.

errors.name: invalid-graph
errors.description: Returned when a base or head graph repeats a node ID or an edge endpoint is outside that graph’s node array. Malformed edge-pair or index JSON is reported as invalid-request instead.

errors.name: unknown-operation
errors.description: Returned when operation is a string other than version or impact. The failure message includes the unsupported operation value.
